supersedes: bmmc-cite-seq-v02-20260926 (never ready: the release block pointed at a not-yet-trained BMMC checkpoint, so the mandatory contract/sealed-evidence checks could not pass for any arm). v0.3 points the release at the frozen shared configuration; targets, nulls, competitor set, budget, arm split, advance rule unchanged.

release.name: spatial-morpheus-v0.1 configuration (frozen code/config; no BMMC-trained checkpoint yet)
release.evidence_note: the release names the frozen representation CONFIGURATION shared by every campaign; no MORPHEUS checkpoint has been trained on BMMC CITE-seq, so the morpheus_factorized arm stays blocked by its own gate (required=false, exists=false) and only the source arm (30 of the 50 frozen candidates) runs; the sealed evidence is the renal development result and is not evidence about this substrate

discovery.candidate_budget_meaning: frozen candidates entering the ledger at stage 'proposed' after the fold sweep; raw per-target proposals are internal search and are never ledger entries. Until a morpheus_factorized checkpoint is trained, only the 'source' arm (30 of the 50) is executable; the remaining 20-candidate 'morpheus_factorized' allocation stays reserved and unfilled rather than being silently reassigned to 'source'.
discovery.environment_unit: donor x site (12 observed batches: 9 donors, 4 sites); donor is the Level-1 fold-grouping unit, site is the Level-2 replication unit
discovery.outer_split: five grouped donor folds over the 9 BMMC donors (grouped by DonorID; a donor's cells across all sites/batches it appears in stay in the same fold), deterministic shuffle with fold_seed; each fold in turn is D_R, the other four are D_P. RNA highest-variance gene selection, size-factor statistics and donor fixed-effect removal are fit on D_P only. This is distinct from the Level-2 held-out-site check below, which groups by Site instead of DonorID.

targets.definition_rule: the target is the surface-protein (ADT) panel measurement itself, response-free by construction: the 134-channel panel composition was fixed by the original GEO/NeurIPS curators before this campaign, never chosen by looking at which channel correlates with any candidate gene. Each of the 134 channels (e.g. CD3, CD4, CD8, CD19, CD14, CD16, CD56, CD25, CD127, HLA-A-B-C, ...; full list = var_names where feature_types==ADT in the released object) is a separate predeclared target; no isotype-control channel names were found in this panel by substring match ('isotype'/'control'/'IgG') but this must be re-verified against the live var_names before the box run and logged, since ADT_iso_count in obs implies isotype background was tracked somewhere in the pipeline even if not as a separate reported channel here.
targets.protein_panel: protein_1..protein_134 placeholder retired -- see 'channels' below for the measured, exact target list
targets.channels_note: the 134 ADT var_names exactly as returned by `anndata.read_h5ad(..., backed='r')` on S/bmmc_cite_reacquired_20260906/GSE194122_openproblems_neurips2021_cite_BMMC_processed.h5ad after `.var_names_make_unique()` (measured on the box 2026-09-26; a name ending '-1', e.g. 'CD86-1', is an ADT channel whose base name collided with a GEX gene symbol and was disambiguated by that call, not a typo); `real_episode`'s own `.var_names_make_unique()` call reproduces these exact strings, so a --target value must be copied verbatim from this list

discovery.candidate_variables: the D_P-selected 300 highest-variance genes from the 13,953-gene GEX block (size-factor normalised per GEX_size_factors, donor fixed effect removed, z-scored with D_P statistics) and, for the morpheus_factorized arm (blocked until trained), its representation coordinates mapped back to genes by response-free observed-coordinate links
excluded_from_candidates: any ADT/protein channel other than the one being modelled as the current target (candidates are RNA-only by design, so the orthogonal-modality relationship is RNA -> protein, never protein -> protein)

always: cell_type (45-class one-hot; controls for the well-known fact that surface-marker level is largely determined by cell identity, so gain measures RNA signal beyond trivial cell-type-average protein expression)
competitor_set.when_candidate_has_context: not applicable in this substrate (no spatial/neighbour context; cells are dissociated)
when_order_ge_3: all pairwise products of the candidate's variables
competitor_set.rule: the simpler model is fit on D_P and frozen; gain = R2(simpler + candidate feature, D_R) - R2(simpler, D_R)
competitor_set.exclusion_clause: the simpler model never contains the response or a deterministic function of it: cell_type is retained in the baseline deliberately (as a confound control), never excluded, because dropping it would let a candidate 'discover' nothing more than cell-identity information already implied by cell_type; receipts record the baseline column names, adopted from the start per the renal_spatial_v03 lesson rather than re-discovered on this substrate

null_suite.within_donor_perm: permutation of the target protein channel's values across cells within donor on D_R (breaks the cell-level RNA-protein pairing while preserving each donor's protein marginal distribution and donor-level batch structure)
null_suite.cross_site_environment_break: block-permutation of the Site label across donors on D_R, holding each cell's real donor/RNA/protein triple fixed, then refitting the site-conditional baseline and recomputing gain (tests whether the observed gain is actually a site-batch artifact rather than a real RNA-protein relationship; if gain is driven by site, it collapses under this null even though the within_donor_perm null may not catch it)

advance_rule.proposed: top 30 (source) + top 20 (morpheus_factorized, currently unfilled/blocked) candidates by mean replication gain over donor-folds in which they recur; recorded with fold_gains, null p per kind, baseline_width, arm, proposal mechanism, budget
advance_rule.internal: recurrence in >= 3 of 5 donor folds with replication gain >= 0.02 in each, both structured nulls p <= 0.05 in the recurring folds, BH q <= 0.10 over the 50 frozen candidates
advance_rule.external: Level 2, held-out site: leave-one-site-out transfer of the frozen candidate (fit on the other 3 sites' donors, evaluated on the held-out site's donors), same sign and p <= 0.05 in at least 3 of the 4 site-holdouts
advance_rule.orthogonal: Level 3 is satisfied automatically upon reaching 'internal', because the response variable (surface protein) is itself an orthogonal assay relative to the RNA candidate features -- no separate acquisition step is required; recorded explicitly in the ledger as 'orthogonal-by-construction' rather than treated as a future action
advance_rule.actionable: Level 4: DepMap 24Q2 CRISPR-dependency lookup (CRISPRGeneEffect.csv) for the frozen candidate gene across hematopoietic/lymphoid-lineage cell lines (Model.csv lineage columns), reported as actionability-adjacent evidence, never as causal or clinical proof; followed by an EIG-ranked discriminating experiment recommendation (e.g. a targeted flow-cytometry or CRISPR-knockdown-plus-CITE-seq validation) -- treatment/clinical claims remain blocked, since no patient-level clinical trial data exists for this cohort

stop_rules: no candidate reaches 'internal' at budget 50: every candidate logged with stop_reason; report 'no discovery at budget 50 under bmmc-cite-seq-v01'; a v0.2 may change the target subset (e.g. restrict to lineage-defining channels only), never this advance rule
all survivors labelled 'known' by the novelty tool (e.g. rediscovering that CD3 transcript predicts CD3 protein): report as independent replication of known biology, no novelty claim
sign reversal on the held-out-site transfer: candidate stops at 'internal'; hash stays locked

morpheus_factorized arm stays at 0/20 filled candidates if no representation checkpoint is trained before the budget sweep: report the source-arm-only 30-candidate result honestly rather than reassigning its budget to source

cohorts.role: fresh measured RNA+protein discovery (Level 1 replication = held-out donors; Level 2 = held-out site)
frozen representation checkpoint for the morpheus_factorized arm

gates.note: gates only the morpheus_factorized arm; the source arm (30 of the 50 frozen candidates) does not need a trained checkpoint and runs first; the MORPHEUS arm is added when the checkpoint exists

translation.depmap: gene-level CRISPR dependency lookup in hematopoietic/lymphoid-lineage cell lines only, reported as actionability-adjacent evidence, never causal or clinical proof
translation.treatment_claim: blocked: no patient-level clinical trial or treatment-outcome data exists for this cohort
forbidden: derived DepMap contrasts as patient-level treatment evidence
calling a held-out donor fold an external (Level 2) replication
treating protein->protein prediction as evidence of an RNA-derived discovery
silently unblocking the morpheus_factorized arm by copying the HEST spatial-morpheus-v0.1 checkpoint onto this substrate
